name: Story Cube
summary: A stories viewer that bursts out of a friend's ring, with live progress bars and a 3D cube turn
about: A phone stories screen where each ring opens into a full-screen story that grows out of the avatar and later shrinks back into it. Progress bars fill story by story, holding pauses everything and hides the bars, and every friend sits on a side of a lit 3D cube that turns under your finger. The pictures are drawn and alive: sunrise over Hunza, Karachi waves, Lahore lanterns and kites over Rawalpindi.
how: Tap a ring: it spins for a moment, then the story bursts out of it and the bars start filling.
Tap the right side for the next story and the left side to go back; press and hold anywhere to pause.
Swipe sideways to turn the cube to the next or previous friend; it follows your finger and springs into place.
Swipe down to close: the story shrinks back into its ring, which turns grey once seen. Like with the heart or type a reply.
Keyboard: Enter opens a ring, arrow keys move between stories (Shift for friends), Space pauses and Escape closes.
